title: Role
description:
Which side a creature is on.

Role is the one piece of allegiance shared by a `Combatant` and its map `Token`, and it
drives more than presentation: it decides token ring colors, whether a creature's experience
counts toward encounter difficulty, whether the app rolls its initiative automatically, and how
labels are assigned.

- Note: A `nil` role is treated as `hostile` throughout, so unclassified creatures behave as
  adversaries.

- SeeAlso: `Combatant/role`, `Token/role`
